checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact TopModule interface; combinational continuous assignments; 100-bit outputs; required zero endpoints and XOR wraparound. No clocks, resets, latches, or pipeline state.

checks.name: Independent self-checking development simulation
checks.details: Zero, ones, alternating patterns, every one-hot and one-cold position, and 1000 random vectors; all 300 output bits checked against per-bit neighbor calculations.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved immediately after implementation and before checks.
limitations: Development simulation covers binary inputs and is not exhaustive over all 100-bit vectors.
Official evaluation was not accessed and its results are unavailable.
No synthesis, Vivado timing/resource evidence, or board testing was performed.
